channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 16 November
item.description: A fix merging a bootstrap update and test work aligning trimmed‑marker handling were applied to the blockchain network. Automated processes ran for another repository. Repositories: SuperGenius, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 15 November
item.description: The wallet added temporary diagnostic prints and enhanced those diagnostics. Automated builds continued for the blockchain component. Repositories: GeniusWallet, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: The blockchain network documentation added a v1.2 roadmap with seven phases and updated requirements, and the RocksDB backup was revised with a new seed note describing a tiered archive model. Repositories: GeniusNetwork.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: The cognitive system removed the GQHSM submodule and updated documentation about its removal. The blockchain network improved cold‑storage handling, retained seal markers, and logged storage gaps. RocksDB backup processes were upgraded with new seed recording. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, GNUS-NEO-SWARM.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: Investor tools received new lockout scenarios, CSV export, formatting fixes, tests, and formula refactoring. The SDK added a payout address function, fixed runner resolution, and switched to self‑hosted runners. A numeric keypad component was added to the openapi client and a warning was removed from third‑party code. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, SuperGenius, GeniusWallet, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: Milestone testing for the blockchain network was completed and old requirement files were archived. New payout address getters were added, wallet earnings reporting was improved, and Idempotency-Key handling was introduced in the SDK. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GeniusWallet, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.
